verses: Uss kitab ka utarna Allah Taalaa ghalib ba-hikmat ki taraf say hai
Yaqeenan hum ney uss kitab ko aap ki taraf haq kay sath nazil farmaya hai pus aap Allah hi ki ibadat keren, ussi kay liye deen ko khalis kertay huye

Khabardaar! Allah Taalaa hi kay liye khalis ibadat kerna hai aur jin logon ney uss kay siwa auliya bana rakhay hain (aur kehtay hain) kay hum unn ki ibadat sirf uss liye kertay hain kay yeh (buzurg) Allah ki nazdeeki kay martaba tak humari rasaee kera den, yeh log jiss baray mein ikhtilaf ker rahey hain uss ka (sacha) faisla Allah (khud) keray ga. Jhootay aur na-shukray (logon) ko Allah Taalaa raah nahi dikhata
Agar Allah Taalaa iradah aulad hi ka hota to apni makhlooq mein say jissay chahata chun leta. (lekin) woh to pak hai, woh o hi Allah Taalaa hai yagana aur qooat wala

Nihayat achi tadbeer say uss ney aasmano aur zamin ko banaya woh raat ko din aur din ko raat per lapet deta hai aur uss ney sooraj aur chand ko kaam per laga rakha hai. Her aik muqarrara muddat tak chal raha hai yaqeen mano kay o hi zabardast aur gunahon ka bakhshney wala hai

Uss ney tum sab ko aik hi jaan say peda kiya hai, phir ussi say uss ka jora peda kiya aur tumharay liye chopayon mein say (aath nurr o madah) utaray woh tumhen tumhari maaon kay peton mein aik banawat kay baad doosri banawat per banata hai teen teen andheron mein, yehi Allah Taalaa tumhara rab hai ussi kay liye badshahat hai, uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi, phir tum kahan behak rahey ho

Agar tum na-shukri kero to (yaad rakho kay) Allah Taalaa tum (sab say) bey niaz hai, aur woh apney bandon ki na-shukri say khush nahi aur agar tum shukar kero to woh ussay tumharay liye pasand keray ga. Aur koi kissi ka bojh nahi uthata phir tum sab ka lotna tumharay rab hi ki taraf hai. Tumhen woh batla dey ga jo tum kertay thay. Yaqeenan woh dilon tak ki baaton ka waqif hai

Aur insan ko jab kabhi koi takleef phonchti hai to woh khoob rujoo ho ker apney rab ko pukarta hai, phir jab Allah Taalaa ussay apney pass say nemat ata farma hai to woh uss say pehlay jo dua kerta tha ussay (bilkul) bhool jata hai aur Allah Taalaa kay shareek muqarrar kerney lagta hai jiss say (auron ko bhi) uss ki raah say behkaye, aap keh dijiye! kay apney kufur ka faeedah kuch din aur utha, (aakhir) to dozakhiyon mein honey wala hai

Bhala jo shakhs raaton kay oqat sajday aur qayam ki halat mein (ibadat mein) guzaarta ho, aakhirat say darta ho aur apney rab ki rehmat ki umeed rakhta ho, (aur jo uss kay bar-aks ho barabar ho saktay hain) batao to ilm walay aur bey ilm kiya barabar kay hain? Yaqeenan naseehat o hi hasil kertay hain jo aqalmand hun. (apney rab ki taraf say)

Keh do kay aey meray eman walay bando! apney rab say dartay raho, jo uss duniya mein neki kertay hain unn kay liye nek badla hai aur Allah Taalaa ki zamin boht kushadah hai sabar kerney walon hi ko unn ka poora poora be-shumaar ajar diya jata hai
Aap keh dijiye! kay mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay Allah Taalaa ki uss tarah ibadat keroon kay ussi kay liye ibadat ko khalis ker loon
Aur mujhay hukum diya gaya hai kay mein sab say pehla farman bardaar bann jaon
Keh dijiye! kay mujhay to apney rab ki na-farmani kertay huye baray din kay azab ka khof lagta hai
Keh dijiye! kay mein to khalis ker kay sirf apney rab hi ki ibadat kerta hun

Tum uss kay siwa jiss ki chahao ibadat kertay raho keh dijiye! kay haqeeqi ziyan kaar woh hain jo apney aap ko aur apney ahl ko qayamat kay din nuksan mein daal den gay, yaad rakho kay khullam khulla nuksan yehi hai
Unhen neechay upper say aag kay (sholay misil) sayebaan (kay) dhank rahey hun gay. Yehi (azab) hai jin say Allah Taalaa apney bandon ko dara raha hai, aey meray bando! pus mujh say dartay raho
Aur jin logon ney taghoot ki ibadat say perhez kiya aur (hama tann) Allah Taalaa ki taraf mutawajha rahey woh khush khabri kay mustahiq hain, meray bandon ko khushkhabri suna dijiye
Jo baat ko kaan laga ker suntay hain. Phir jo behtareen baat ho uss ki ittabaa kertay hain. Yehi hain jinhen Allah Taalaa ney hidayat ki hai aur yehi aqalmand bhi hain
Bhala jiss shakhs per azab ki baat sabit ho chuki hai, to kiya aap ussay jo dozakh mein hai chura saktay hain?

Haan woh log jo apney rab say dartay rahey unn kay liye bala khaney hain jin kay upper bhi banay banaye bala khaney hain (aur) unn kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain. Rab ka wada hai aur woh wada khilafi nahi kerta

Kiya aap ney nahi dekha kay Allah Taalaa aasman say pani utarta hai aur ussay zamin ki sooton mein phonchata hai, phir ussi kay zariye say mukhtalif qasam ki khetiyan ugata hai phir woh khushk ho jati hain aur aap unhen zard rang dekhtay hain phir unhen reza reza ker deta hai, uss mein aqal mandon kay liye boht ziyadah naseehat hai

Kiya woh shakhs jiss ka seena Allah Taalaa islam kay liye khol diya hai pus woh apney perwerdigar ki taraf say aik noor per hai aur halaki hai unn per jin kay dil yaad elahi say (asar nahi letay balkay)yeh) sakht ho gaye hain. Yeh log sareeh gumrahi mein (mubtila) hain

Allah Taalaa ney behtareen kalaam nazil farmaya hai jo aisi kitab hai kay aapas mein milti julti aur baar baar dohraee hui aayaton ki hai, jiss say unn logon kay rongtay kharay ho jatay hain jo apney rab ka khof rakhtay hain aakhir mein unn kay jism aur dil Allah Taalaa kay zikar ki taraf naram ho jatay hain, yeh hai Allah Taalaa ki hidayat jiss kay zariye jissay chahaye raah raast per laga deta hai. Aur jissay Allah Taalaa hi raah bhala dey uss ka hadi koi nahi
Bhala jo shakhs qayamat kay din kay bad-tareen azab ki sapar (dhaal) apney mun ko banaye ga. (aisay) zalimon say kaha jaye ga kay apney kiye ka (wabaal) chakho
Unn say pehlay walon ney bhi jhutlaya, phir unn per o haan say azab para jahan say unn ko khayal bhi na tha
Aur Allah Taalaa ney unhen zindagani duniya mein ruswaee ka maza chakhaya aur abhi aakhirat ka to bara bhari azab hai kaash kay yeh log samajh len
Aur yaqeenan hum ney uss Quran mein logon kay liye her qasam ki misalen biyan ker den hain kiya ajab kay woh naseehat hasil ker len
Quran hai arabi mein jiss mein koi kuji nahi, ho sakta hai kay woh perhezgari ikhtiyar ker len

Allah Taalaa misal biyan farma raha hai aik woh shakhs jiss mein boht say bahum zidd rakhney walay sajhi hain, aur doosra woh shakhs jo sirf aik hi ka (ghulam) hai, kiya yeh dono sift mein yaksan hain, Allah Taalaa hi kay liye sab tareef hai. Baat yeh hai kay unn mein kay aksar log samajhtay nahi
Yaqeenan khud aap ko bhi maut aaye gi aur yeh sab bhi marney walay hain
Phir tum sab kay sab qayamat walay din apney rab kay samney jhagro gay
Uss say barh ker zalim kaun hai jo Allah Taalaa per jhoot bolay? Aur sacha deen jab uss kay pass aaye to ussay jhoota bataye? Kiya aisay kuffaar kay liye jahannum thikana nahi hai?
Aur jo sachay deen ko laye aur jiss ney uss ki tasdeeq ki yehi log paarsa hain
Unn kay liye unn kay rab kay pass (her) woh cheez hai jo yeh chahayen, nek logon ka yehi badla hai
Takay Allah Taalaa unn say unn kay buray amalon ko door kerdey aur jo nek kaam unhon ney kiye hain unn ka acha badla ata farmaye
Kiya Allah Taalaa apney banday kay liye kafi nahi? Yeh log aap ko Allah kay siwa auron say dara rahey hain aur jissay Allah gumrah ker dey uss ki rehnumaee kerney wala koi nahi
Aur jissay woh hidayat dey ussay koi gumrah kerney wala nahi kiya Allah Taalaa ghalib aur badla lenay wala nahi hai?

Agar aap unn say poochen kay aasman o zamin ko kiss ney peda kiya hai? To yaqeenan woh yehi jawab den gay kay Allah ney. Aap unn say kahiye kay acha yeh to batao jinhen tum Allah kay siwa pukartay ho agar Allah Taalaa mujhay nuksan phonchana chahaye to kiya yeh uss kay nuksan ko hata saktay hain? Ya Allah Taalaa mujh per meharbani ka iradah keray to kiya yeh uss ki meharbani ko rok saktay hain? Aap keh den kay Allah mujhay kafi hai, tawakkal kerney walay ussi per tawakkal kertay hain
Keh dijiye kay aey meri qom! tum apni jagah per amal kiye jao mein bhi amal ker raha hun, abhi abhi tum jaan lo gay
Kay kiss per ruswa kerney wala azab aata hai aur kiss per daeemi maar aur hameshgi ki saza hoti hai

Aap per hum ney haq kay sath yeh kitab logon kay liye nazil farmaee hai, pus jo shakhs raah raast per aajaye uss kay apney liye nafa hai aur jo gumrah hojaye uss ki gumrahi ka (wabaal) ussi per hai, aap unn kay zimmay daar nahi

Allah hi roohon ko unn ki maut kay waqt aur jin ki maut nahi aaee unhen unn ki neend kay waqt qabz ker leta hai, phir jin per maut ka hukum lag chuka hai unhen to rok leta hai aur doosri (roohon) ko aik muqarrar waqt tak kay liye chor deta hai. Ghor kerney walon kay liye uss mein yaqeenan boht si nishaniyan hain
Kiya unn logon ney Allah Taalaa kay siwa (auron) ko sifarshi muqarrar ker rakha hai? Aap keh dijiye! kay go woh kuch bhi ikhtiyar na rakhtay hun aur na aqal rakhtay hun
Keh dijiye! kay tamam sifarish ka mukhtar Allah hi hai. Tamam aasmano aur zamin ka raaj ussi kay liye hai tum sab ussi ki taraf pheray jao gay

Jab Allah akelay ka zikar kiya jaye to unn logon kay dil nafrat kerney lagtay hain jo aakhirat yaqeen nahi rakhtay aur jab uss kay siwa (aur ka) zikar kiya jaye to unn kay dil khul ker khush ho jatay hain
Aap keh dijiye! kay aey Allah! aasmano aur zamin kay peda kerney walay, chupay khulay kay jannay walay to hi apney bandon mein unn umoor ka faisla farmaye ga jin mein woh ulajh rahey thay

Agar zulm kerney walon kay pass woh sab kuch ho jo aur zamin per hai aur uss kay sath itna hi aur ho, to bhi bad-tareen saza kay badlay mein qayamat kay din yeh sab kuch dey den, aur unn kay samney Allah ki taraf say woh zahir hoga jiss ka guman bhi unhen na tha
Jo kuch unhon ney kiya tha uss ki buraiyan unn per khul paren gi aur jiss ka woh mazaq kertay thay aur woh unhen aa gheray ga

Insan ko jab koi takleef phonchti hai to humen pukarney lagta hai, phir jab hum ussay apni taraf say koi nemat ata farma to kehney lagta hai kay ussay to mein mehaz apney ilm ki wajah say diya gaya hun, balkay)yeh yeh aazmaeesh hai lekin unn mein say aksar log bey ilm hain
Unn say aglay bhi yehi baat keh chukay hain pus unn ki kaarawaee unn kay kuch kaam na aaee
Phir unn ki tamam buraiyan unn per aa paren, aur unn mein say bhi jo gunah gaar hain unn ki ki hui buraiyan bhi abb unn per aa paren gi, yeh (humen) hara denay walay nahi
Kiya unhen yeh maloom nahi kay Allah Taalaa jiss kay liye chahaye rozi kushadah ker deta hai aur tang (bhi), eman laney walon kay liye uss mein (bari bari) nishaniyan hain

(meri janib say) keh do kay aey meray bando! jinhon ney apni janon per ziyadti ki hai tum Allah ki rehmat say na-umeed na ho jao, bil-yaqeen Allah Taalaa saray gunahon ko bakhsh deta hai, waqaee woh bari bakhsish bari rehmat wala hai
Tum (sab) apney perwerdigar ki taraf jhuk paro aur uss ki hukum bardari kiye jao uss say qabal kay tumharay pass azab aa jaye aur phir tumhari madad na ki jaye
Aur pairwee kero uss behtareen cheez jo tumhari taraf tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say nazil ki gaee hai, uss say pehlay kay tum per achanak azab aajaye aur tumhen itlaa bhi na ho
(aisa na ho kay) koi shakhs kahey haaye afsos! uss baat per kay mein ney Allah Taalaa kay haq mein kotahi ki balkay)yeh mein to mazaq uraney walon mein hi raha
Ya kahey kay agar Allah mujhay hidayat kerta to mein bhi paarsa logon mein hota
Ya azab ko dekh ker kahey kaash! kay kissi tarah mera lot jana hojata to mein bhi neko kaaron mein hojata
Haan (haan) be-shak teray pass meri aayaten phonch chuki thin jinhen tu ney jhutlaya aur ghuroor o takabbur kiya aur to tha hi kafiron mein
Aur jin logon ney Allah per jhoot bandha hai to aap dekhen gay kay qayamat kay din unn kay chehray siyah hogaye hun gay kiya takabbur kerney walon thikana jahannum mein nahi?
Aur jin logon ney perhezgari ki unhen Allah Taalaa unn ki kaamyabi kay sath bacha ley ga, unhen koi dukh chu bhi na sakay ga aur na woh kissi tarah ghumgeen hun gay
Allah her cheez ka peda kerney wala hai aur o hi her cheez per nigehbaan hai
Aasmano aur zamin ki kunjiyon malik o hi hai jin jin logon ney Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya o hi khasarah paney walay hain
Aap keh dijiye aey jahilo! kiya tum mujh say Allah kay siwa auron ki ibadat ko kehtay ho

Yaqeenan teri taraf bhi aur tujh say pehlay (kay tamam nabiyon) ki taraf bhi wahee ki gaee hai kay agar tu ney shirk kiya to bila-shuba tera amal zaya ho jaye ga aur bil-yaqeen to kaaron mein say hojaye ga
Balkay)yeh to Allah hi ki ibadat ker aur shukar kerney walon mein say ho jaa

Aur unn logon ney jaisi qadar Allah Taalaa ki kerni chahaiye thi nahi ki, sari zamin qayamat kay din uss ki muthi mein hogi aur tamam aasman uss kay dahanay hath mein lapetay huye hun gay, woh pak aur bartar hai her uss cheez say jissay log uss ka shareek banayen

Aur soor phoonk diya jaye ga pus aasmano aur zamin walay sab bey hosh hoker gir paren gay magar jissay Allah chahaye, phir doobara soor phonka jaye ga pus woh aik dum kharay ho ker dekhney lag jayen gay

Aur zamin apney perwerdigar kay noor say jagmaga uthay gi, nama aemaal hazir kiye jayen gay nabiyon aur gawahon ko laya jaye ga aur logon kay darmiyan haq haq faislay ker diye jayen gay, aur woh zulm na kiye jayen gay
Aur jiss shakhs ney jo kuch kiya hai bharpoor dey diya jaye ga, jo kuch log ker rahey hain woh bakhoobi jannay wala hai

Kafiron kay ghol kay ghol jahannum ki taraf hankaye jayen gay, jab woh uss kay pass phonch jayen gay uss kay darwazay unn kay liye khol diye jayen gay, aur o haan kay nigehbaan unn say sawal keren gay kay kiya tumharay pass tum mein say rasool nahi aaye thay? Jo tum per tumharay rab ki aayaten parhtay thay aur tumhen uss din ki mulaqat say daratay thay? Yeh jawab den gay kay haan durust hai lekin azab ka hukum kafiron per sabit ho gaya
Kaha jaye ga kay abb jahannum kay darwazon mein dakhil ho jao jahan hamesha rahen gay, pus sirkashon ka thikana boht hi bura hai

Aur jo log apney rab say dartay thay unn kay giroh kay giroh jannat ki taraf rawana kiye jayen gay yahan tak kay jab uss kay pass aa jayen gay aur darwazay khol diye jayen gay aur o haan kay nigehbaan unn say kahen gay tum per salam ho, tum khush haal raho tum uss mein hamesha kay liye chalay jao

Yeh kahen gay kay Allah shukar hai kay jiss ney hum say apna wada poora kiya aur humen uss zamin ka waris bana diya kay jannat mein jahan chahayen muqam keren pus amal kerney walon ka kiya hi acha badla hai

Aur to farishton ko Allah kay arsh kay ird-gird halqa bandhay huye apney rab ki hamd o tasbeeh kertay huye dekhay ga aur unn mein insaf ka faisla kiya jaye ga aur keh diya jaye ga kay sari khoobi Allah hi kay liye hai jo tamam jahano ka palanhaar hai
